## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Tech is the clearest source of strength but leadership is narrow: ORCL (1W: +20.57% | 1M: +35.92%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +12.79% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND; sector performance positive on 1W (Technology: 1W +5.33% | 1M +17.67%, 24 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Maintain neutral positioning and be selective: monitor Tech leaders (ORCL, INTC, NVDA) for momentum trades and favor trimming exposure to Energy laggards (OXY, COP, XOM) and names showing trend exhaustion (PYPL, SLB). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak sector breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +20.57% | 1M: +35.92%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +16.02% | 1M: +85.95%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.22% | 1M: +76.20%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: OXY (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -9.75%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.02% | 1M: -6.17%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (1W +5.33% | 1M +17.67%) — momentum concentrated in semiconductors. BEARISH: Energy (1W -6.33% | 1M -2.94%) and Utilities (1W -3.43% | 1M -2.57%) as sources of downside risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch for sustained follow-through on weekly breakouts in ORCL/INTC/AMD to confirm momentum; watch OXY/COP for failure to reclaim prior support as a sign of deeper Energy weakness; monitor JPM for a reclaim of monthly trend to re-assess Financials exposure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
QCOM (+60): QCOM (1W: +12.79% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND — buyback/partnership headlines are confirming price momentum. (Other high-sentiment names in the feed lack dual-timeframe data in this packet for cross-check.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?

GOOGL (-45): GOOGL (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment negative, price confirms accumulation (divergence). PYPL (-45): PYPL (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +0.81%) TREND EXHAUSTION — bearish headlines align with short-term weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Tech in Top 5).  
Technology names ORCL (1W: +20.57% | 1M: +35.92%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +16.02% | 1M: +85.95%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength.  
Key risk is narrow leadership and headline-driven divergences (AAPL/GOOGL up despite negative headlines; Energy names confirming downside) — monitor sentiment and trend breaks.
